title: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2
summary: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2 is a comprehensive benchmarking report that evaluates and ranks AI language models across multiple dimensions including performance, cost, and efficiency. This periodic index helps track the evolving landscape of AI capabilities and provides comparative analysis for different AI models and providers.
problem_solved: Provides standardized metrics and comparisons to evaluate and rank AI models, helping stakeholders make informed decisions about AI implementations.
why_valuable: Offers objective, data-driven comparisons of AI models that enable developers and businesses to select appropriate solutions based on performance and cost trade-offs.
